notes.title: Released!
notes.content: Skip's Sanity has been released!  Version 1.0 is live in the store.  It's been a long road to get to this point but the journey is far from over.  I will continue to monitor the community for any issues or requests.  I hope you have as much fun playing Skip's Sanity as I had making it!

notes.title: Skip's Sanity Coming This Month!
notes.content:
We are currently deep in beta testing, making sure that everything works correctly and delivers the most fun possible!  Looking forward to the release on May 25th.  

A special thanks to all the beta testers in finding bugs and improving various aspects of gameplay.
